definitions.gloss: main body (of an army, expedition, or group); main force
definitions.explanation: The main, larger part of a military unit, expedition or touring group, as opposed to an advance party sent ahead or a detachment split off from it.

examples.japanese: {本隊|ほんたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{本隊|ほんたい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{合流|ごうりゅう}→合流：11902_gouryuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{先発隊|せんぱつたい}→先発隊：28032_senpatsutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}り→張る：12583_haru⟧、⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本隊|ほんたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{山小屋|やまごや}→山小屋：18402_yamagoya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: The advance party pitched the tents, and the main group reached the mountain hut in the evening.

notes:
Used for troops, expeditions, rescue teams and large tour groups.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本隊|ほんたい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{合流|ごうりゅう}→合流：11902_gouryuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rejoin the main body
- {本隊|ほんたい}⟦に{先立|さきだ}って→に先立って：26555_nisakidatte⟧: ahead of the main body
- {本隊|ほんたい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧: to become separated from the main group

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本体|ほんたい}→本体：13033_hontai⟧: same reading, but means the main unit of a machine or the true substance of something, not a group of people
